g.text: Synthetic 200 × 200-pixel Sentinel-1-like scene (VV and VH, before and after, about 4.4 looks) over a valley; floodwater fills land up to 2–5 m above the river
(HAND, uneven), plus a few ponds; the HAND map given to the models carries ±1.5 m DEM errors. Look-alikes: smooth sand or tarmac, radar shadow on hills; flooded
forest and buildings appear bright. Random forest: 150 trees, 8 features, trained on three other scenes.
